title: Patch swimlane orchestration quicknotes and calendar (Nov 2025 draft)
content:
Purpose: compact runbook for 1–2 hour patch windows where we partition traffic by swimlane, reduce blast radius, and preserve latency SLOs. This is a working draft: assumes small batch hotfixes, incremental config flips and a pre-approved rollback image.

Scope: applies to hosted API & Dedicated pools in us-west1/us-east1 only for non-database migrations. If DB or schema changes are required, escalate to PM + infra lead; follow full deployment playbook.

Week-of calendar (high level):
- Mon 2025-11-10: Dry-run rehearsal (team only, no traffic). Verify telemetry queries and smoke tests.
- Tue 2025-11-11: Final artifact bake (cut final image, tag rc/patch-20251111).
- Wed 2025-11-12 02:00-05:00 UTC: Quiet window for swimlane rollout. Primary rollout lane at 02:30 UTC.
- Wed 2025-11-12 08:00-10:00 UTC: Extended observation & cleanup.

Pre-flight checklist (48–2h before):
- [ ] Confirm ticket REL-842 acceptance criteria and rollback criteria are documented.
- [ ] Build artifact present in registry with immutability tag (rc/patch-20251111).
- [ ] Smoke test script reviewed and owner assigned. Smoke test owners: Luis (api), Claire (ingest).
- [ ] Telemetry queries checked: 5xx rate, p95 latency, token consumption. Saved queries: telemetry/patch-swimlane.
- [ ] Alert suppression plan drafted for non-actionable alerts; SRE notified.
- [ ] Slack: #deployments and #oncall alerting channel invited.

Day-of (window minute-by-minute):
- T-60: Standup with cross-team reps (eng, sre, product). Confirm go/no-go.
- T-30: Warm lanes: deploy to staging pool and run smoke.
- T-10: Toggle readiness probe ramp to fast-scan.
- T+0: Shift 2% traffic to patch lane (swimlane A) for 5m. Monitor errors & latency.
- T+5m: If healthy, shift 10% for 10m. If healthy, continue 25% -> 50% over next 30m increments.
- If any threshold breached (p95 > SLA + 30ms OR errors > 0.5%), revert immediately to previous stable image and notify bridge.

Rollback & emergency steps:
- Quick revert command (ops runbook): infra/rollback-cmd --pool <pool> --image <stable-tag>. (Owner: Samir)
- If rollback fails, divert traffic to standby region (us-east1) and engage incident lead.

Post-release (0–72h):
- [ ] Run full regression suite the morning after.
- [ ] Run cost/throughput sampling: compare token throughput to baseline.
- [ ] Draft release notes brief for TL;DR: include user-visible changes, config keys toggled, and migration notes.

Draft release notes (to be cleaned for customer-facing):
- Patch release 2025-11-12 (rc/patch-20251111)
- Fixes: intermittent timeout on streaming responses under high concurrency; corrected cache eviction edge case that caused duplicate embeddings for repeated prefix requests.
- Config toggles: enabled adaptive-prefetch=false for swimlane A during rollout.
- Risk: low — changes limited to request routing and cache management. No model changes.

Telemetry & signals to watch (saved queries):
- telemetry/patch-swimlane: p95 latency (svc-frontend), 5xx rate, duplicate-response metric, cache-hits ratio.
- tracing: sample traces where response > 2s.

Communications matrix:
- Primary bridge: #deployments (public); private bridge thread in #deployments --> thread titled "patch-swimlane-20251112".
- Oncall: eng-sre rotation for Nov 10–14: Pager duty group A.
- Customer comms: only if rollback or user-facing degradation; message template in linked Confluence page.

Notes & open questions:
- Do we want to trial a 3-way swimlane (A/B/heat) for later windows? Prospectively yes, but requires routing config work and QA.
- Validate token billing anomalies for short patch ramps (billing smoothing).

Action items (owners):
- Ava: finalize smoke tests and confirm staging artifact (due 2025-11-11).
- Luis: author telemetry queries & dashboard (due 2025-11-10).
- Claire: lead dry-run and record checklist gaps (due 2025-11-10).
- Samir: prepare rollback scripts and validate permissions (due 2025-11-11).

Appendix: quick commands (copy-paste during ops)
- Deploy to lane: infra/deploy --pool api-pool-us-west1 --image rc/patch-20251111 --lane swimlane-A
- Shift traffic: infra/traffic-shift --pool api-pool-us-west1 --lane swimlane-A --percent 25
- Revert: infra/rollback-cmd --pool api-pool-us-west1 --image stable/20251027

End of draft. Add comments inline or ping authors on Slack for updates.
